label: FASTHENRY MEASUREMENT BURST (founder decision 2026-11-18, O004 state log): the k0 and k1 levels (nh 5) of the three Case 4 F7(a) layouts only, a subset of research/o004_f7/vm_jobs_fasthenry.json, to measure k1's run time and the k0-to-k1 ratio step before the founder chooses the FastHenry route at the 2026-11-27 thesis review. command: uv run python experiments/runners/e004_run.py --dev-fh-run research/o004_f7/vm_jobs_fasthenry.json (on the VM: MF_E004_MEM_GB=108; resumes from research/o004_f7/fh_solves)
first_vm_step: the probe of every deck marked precond_probe = vm_first: `e004_run.py --dev-fh-probe 108` before the full runs (review T0427/T0428 A)

binary.rule: fasthenry_run.self_test() once per host, stored keyed by binary_sha256 beside every result

levels.pinned_meaning: D0002's provisioned FastHenry 3.0wr (research/o006_p4/binary_check.json); self_test() once per host, its record stored keyed by binary_sha256 beside every FHResult
levels.no_direct_fallback: O004 F1. Direct LU needs 8 F^2 bytes (P4), about 41 GB at k0's 72k filaments on Case 4
levels.nh_lateral_meaning: the lateral ladder's thickness filaments (traces and planes), a level of the 3 / 5 / 9 ladder and never 1 (founder, T0417/T0418: nh = 1 is +24 % on a thin-ceramic stack). PROVISIONAL: F7(a)'s thickness ladder decides it before registration (founder); 5 is the middle of the ladder, so its thickness term is the error of the value judged
levels.lateral_meaning: three levels at ratio 2 in every lateral knob: trace cell, plane pitch (coarsest 2 mm, F7(a); P4's 4 mm plane cell caused its k0-to-k1 ratio step), and the wire section refined with the traces (wire_n filaments per side and wire_sub pieces per polyline segment, review T0362); wire_n = wire_sub = 1 is never used (T0385: NaN impedance)
levels.memory_cap_policy: review T0455 / T0457 item 11: cap = projection x cap_factor (1.5), the projection being kb_per_filament x exporter filaments x mem_margin 1.30 (the adapter's MEM_MARGIN; research/o004_f7/fh_direct_mem.json: direct-mode peaks 1.01-1.09 x the dense estimate in-repo, 1.24-1.26 in T0428's runs; T0457's four local multipole solves of the Case 4 k0 nh5 decks in research/o004_f7/fh_local_probe.json (case4_base twice, dev03_trace_width, standin_compound) peaked at 0.91-1.21 x the projection = 1.18-1.58 x the raw 31.1 kB/filament figure, so a cap at the projection would have killed three of the four; cap_factor 1.5 leaves 24 % over the largest measurement for the extrapolation to the k1 / k2 decks, which are not measured locally). A run killed at its cap (killed_memory) is retried ONCE, alone, at the machine's full budget (0.97 x MF_E004_MEM_GB) before its value is recorded as missing, so a mis-projected cap cannot by itself turn a judged value into a missing one and the run into INVALID; both attempts are recorded
levels.timeout_rule: review T0453 / T0457 item 10: at plan time every FastHenry job's timeout, doubled for its full-memory retry, must fit the spec's timeout_min (assert_timeouts_fit); the stage refuses before any solve otherwise
levels.sizing_meaning: explicit mem_cap_mb and timeout_s per job (reviews T0427/T0428 B(2)): projected peak = 31.1 kB per exporter filament (P4's largest per-filament multipole peak, 0.78 GB at 25,056) x 1.3 margin for FastHenry's own refinement (the post-refinement count is known only once a run starts, T0385 (3)); time = 1,246 s x (F / 102,192)^1.40 (P4 k1 and its k0 -> k1 exponent), timeout 10 x that (T0389: gen2_0 reached the preconditioner only after 15 x the projected total, so the time rule is layout-dependent; F7(a) recalibrates it per reference before registration). A timeout or a memory kill is not retried and leaves a missing value
levels.always_crash_rule: review T0427/T0428 A: a deck that crashes on every multipole attempt has no value; no direct fallback, no other level substituted; F1 makes the estimate it feeds +inf (exclusion) and a missing finest value goes to the INVALID rule. Decks probed before registration: research/o004_f7/fh_probe.json and vm_jobs_fasthenry.json (precond_probe)

die_model: short on every job (no distributed-die deck: no direct solve is needed or projected, T0385 (2))
wire_rule: no job uses wire_n = 1 with wire_sub = 1 (T0385 (1)); each job records wire_n and wire_sub

gap_rule.quantity: g(X) = L_FH(X, nh 5 at cell 0.5 mm, plane 2 mm, wire 2/2) / L_l2(X, lat0.5) - 1 at 10 and 20 MHz, X in {gen2_0, case4_base}; T(X) = 3 |L_FH(nh 5) - L_FH(nh 3)| / L_FH(nh 5) (two-level, p = 1)
gap_rule.closes_if: |g(gen2_0)| <= |g(case4_base)| + 0.02 (Case 4's few percent, measured at identical levels) AND T(gen2_0) <= 0.01 (the thickness term inside the 1 % estimate), at both frequencies
gap_rule.otherwise: the thin-stack gap stays open: no non-Case-4 FastHenry deck is relied on and E004's nh_lateral is revisited by the founder before registration (T0417/T0418)

always_crash_rule: a multipole deck that crashes on every attempt (retries up to 10; the adapter stops early on a repeated identical exit) has no value: no direct fallback (O004 F1: direct needs 8 F^2 bytes, far above any machine for these decks), no other level substituted; F1 makes the affected estimate +inf (exclusion), a missing finest value goes to the INVALID rule
memory_rule: mem_proj_gb = kb_per_filament x exporter filaments x mem_margin (config.solve.fasthenry.sizing; margin covers FastHenry's post-refinement growth, unknown before the run, T0385 (3)); every attempt's peak_mem_mb and wall_s are recorded

projection.parallelism: memory-packed (run_jobs, MF_E004_MEM_GB=108): at most 6 jobs at once in the projected schedule; never by CPU count
projection.max_hours_rule: ceil(1.25 x the upper-envelope makespan): burst_gcp.sh's default of 6 h stopped burst 1 early; launch with MF_GCP_MAX_HOURS set to this value

time_calibration.rule: time = t_ref x (F / f_ref)^exponent x the layout's measured factor (Case 4 layouts: the largest local full-solve factor; gen2_0: the preconditioner probe's lower bound)

exponent_refit.note: fewer than 3 local points over a filament range wider than 10 %: no slope fitted
exponent_refit.rule: the k2 upper envelope is time_proj_s x (F / f_ref)^u with u = max(the spec's exponent_uncertainty, |b| + se(b)); the calibration factor itself is the largest measured Case 4 factor (load averages recorded: the Mac was shared with another agent, so part of each factor is contention)

memory_calibration.rule: cap = projection (kb_per_filament x F x mem_margin 1.30) x cap_factor; a run killed at its cap is retried once alone at the machine's full budget (memory_cap_policy)

level_risk.reading: direct: k1 lateral at nh 1 runs at 8.00 x the rule against 1.57 x for k0's lateral (m1 = 5.08, a lower bound: timeout); factorial: slow features none
level_risk.rule: direct (k1lat measured): k1 jobs x m1 in time_proj_s and time_hi_s, k2 jobs x m1 in time_proj_s and x m1^2 in time_hi_s; otherwise the upper envelope of every job with a risky feature (wire_sub >= 2 / cell <= 0.5 mm / nh 1) x g_factor / k_factor

projection.uncertainty: exponent 1.4 +- 0.30 beyond P4's largest run (102192 filaments; not widened by the refit: the k-level local points span 71-74k filaments, no slope): the k2 decks (~1.2 M filaments, 11x past calibration) carry a factor 2.1 up or down; the widening from the measured misses is the level risk (level_risk: the k1 lateral level measured at >= 8x the rule against 1.6x at k0's lateral, so k1 decks x m1 in time_proj_s and k2 decks x m1 in time_proj_s and x m1^2 in time_hi_s); time_hi_s is the upper envelope; the measured misses (gen2_0 >= 15x, a lower bound, so gen2_0's time_hi_s is NOT an upper bound; Case 4 local factor above) are applied as calibration and timeouts are 10 x the calibrated projection

thickness_share_rule: T0454 item 6: the F7(a) report gives, per pair X in {standin_compound, dev03_trace_width} against case4_base and per frequency, FastHenry's ratio thickness term (e004_run.fh_terms(ratio=True)['thickness']) / r_fh(k2) / 0.01, the share of F1's 1 % cap (rows field fh_thickness_share_of_cap in the solve stage); the current values are in 'thickness_share' (pending until the burst results exist)

timeouts_fit.error: a FastHenry job's timeout x 2 (with its full-memory retry) 1734576 s exceeds the experiment's timeout_min (360000 s)
timeouts_fit.consequence: the registered solve stage would refuse before any solve (assert_timeouts_fit); the timeout rule, timeout_min or the ladder needs a founder decision before registration

e004_cost_plan.max_hours_rule: ceil(1.25 x the upper-envelope makespan: the exponent envelope and the level risk of projection.level_risk)
e004_cost_plan.note: pairs sized as their reference; l2_layout at the measured Case 4 peaks (15.9 GB at 0.25 mm, T0387), a conservative bound for 2R / Case 6 (Case 6 0.25 mm: 4.75 GB)
